provenance.notes: Real downloads. Purchases negative, payments positive. Memo is usually empty, so lines end in a comma. Variants not rendered: a leading Card column with 2-digit years, and the 2012-2018 `Type,Trans Date,Post Date,Description,Amount` layout. Chase caps a download at 1,000 rows. Category values are Chase's names, mapped from our categories.
Real downloads. Data rows have one more field than the 7-column header (a trailing comma); the header doesn't. CRLF. Description always quoted. Details is DEBIT/CREDIT/CHECK/DSLIP.

Real downloads. A 5-line summary and a blank line come before the header; the first row is a 'Beginning balance' line with no amount. Amounts quoted with thousands separators. CRLF, oldest first. Bank of America ended QFX/OFX downloads on 2025-09-30, so only CSV is rendered. Not rendered: one 2025 sample has an unescaped quote inside a Zelle description.
Real downloads. Payee and Address quoted and space-padded, so readers must trim. Real reference numbers are 17-23 digits; here they are TD.1's ids. Purchases negative.
The layout until about 2025: no header; every field quoted; date, signed amount, `*`, check number, description. Line ending not confirmed (CRLF used).
The 2026 layout: a quoted header row; values quoted except empty ones (an empty check number is `,,`). STATUS seen as `Posted`; the pending value is assumed, so this corpus lists posted rows only.

Real downloads. Purchases are positive in Debit; credits are printed as NEGATIVE numbers in the Credit column. Status is Cleared or Pending, and pending rows are included. One date column. Older files have no Member Name column.
ISO dates, unsigned Debit and Credit columns, the card's last 4 digits. CRLF. Category values are Capital One's names, mapped from our categories.
Capital One 360 checking and savings: 2-digit years; unsigned amounts with the direction in Transaction Type (Debit or Credit).

Every field quoted, header included. Transaction is DEBIT, CREDIT or the check number. This is the newer era (ISO dates, 2 decimals) reported by importer projects in 2026; older files use M/D/YYYY and 4-decimal amounts and put a reference in Memo.
From a 2017 sample: unquoted header, every data field quoted, amounts with `$` and thousands separators, withdrawals positive. Not confirmed for the current site.

The layout Truist introduced at the end of 2025 (column names from parser code; quoting not confirmed). Merchant name is the clean merchant. Category values are reconstructed from our own category names. Daily Posted Balance is rendered as the running balance after each row.
The basic download. Charges are POSITIVE; payments and credits negative. Descriptions keep Amex's internal space padding.

The 'include additional details' download. Extended Details, Address and City/State contain line breaks inside quotes. Reference is wrapped in single quotes. Charges positive. Category is `Group-Subgroup` (mapped from our categories).
Real download. Purchases are POSITIVE, payments negative (some articles say otherwise; real files don't). CRLF; Description and Category quoted. Discover dropped QFX downloads around 2022.
Issued by Goldman Sachs. Dates unquoted, every other field quoted, the amount included. Purchases positive. Merchant is the clean merchant name. Exported per monthly statement or for a date range.
Real download. The header has a space after each comma (so the names start with a space); data rows don't. ISO date plus a time column.

Every field quoted, amounts with `$`. Status is Posted or Pending, and pending rows are included (no running balance yet). Type values ACH, TRANSFER and INTADJUST are confirmed; the others are assumed. Older files use Credits/Debits/TransactionType and `#` comment lines.

Real download. Description is USAA's cleaned name (our payee); Original Description is the raw text. Status is Posted or Pending, and pending rows are included. USAA no longer offers QFX. Category values are USAA-style names mapped from our categories.

The 2026 layout: UTF-8 BOM, Rewards Total and Rewards Type at the end. Amount is unsigned; Credit Debit Indicator gives the direction. Note the lowercase `type` header. Type, Type Group and Category values are assumed.
ISO dates, unsigned Debit and Credit, the routing and account number on every row (fake here). Descriptions end with a trailing space, so readers must trim. Transaction Type values are assumed.

Barclays US cards. Four lines before the header (bank name, masked account, balance, a line with a single space). Its Category column is really DEBIT or CREDIT. Purchases negative. A possible 2026 variant adds card digits and 'Purchased by' (not rendered).

OFX 1.0.2 SGML without closing tags. A blank line before OFXHEADER, `[0:GMT]` times, no MEMO, TRNTYPE DEBIT or CREDIT only. NAME isn't held to 32 characters at Chase. Real card FITIDs can be synthetic strings (not rendered).
Same identifiers as the card download. Both NAME and MEMO carry the description; NAME seen up to 35 characters. TRNTYPE DEBIT or CREDIT only.
OFX 1.0.2 SGML. NAME truncated to 32 characters with the full text in MEMO. TRNTYPE POS for card purchases and DIRECTDEBIT for ACH. Real MEMOs can carry `?MCC=` codes (not rendered).

Downloaded through the Citibank banking login: the card comes as a BANK statement with ACCTTYPE CREDITLINE, not a credit-card statement. No time-zone suffix. The Citi Cards login (INTU.BID 4894) may differ.
Closed leaf tags, DTUSER present, NAME and MEMO identical. Real files also put a nonstandard CCACCTTO inside each STMTTRN (not rendered).
OFX 2.0.2 XML. No NAME at all: the description is only in MEMO. INTU.BID 17410 ('Capital One Bank - New', 2026); older files have 1236. Real DTSERVER values are malformed (not rendered).
OFX 1.0.2 SGML. NAME cut to 32 characters (real files pad it with trailing spaces, not rendered); real MEMOs hold `reference; MCC;` (not rendered).
OFX 1.0.2 SGML with `[-4:EDT]` times, DTUSER present, and DTSTART set to the Unix epoch whatever range was asked for. Real amounts can have one decimal (`88.0`; not rendered).
OFX 1.0.2 SGML on a single line, `[-7:MST]` times. Real files add proprietary tags (ORIGIN.ID, AMEX.BASICACCT and others) and a REFNUM equal to FITID (not rendered).
OFX 1.0.2 SGML on a single line, `[0:GMT]` times, TRNTYPE DEBIT, CREDIT or INT, NAME up to 32 characters, no MEMO. Real FITIDs are UUIDs.
An SGML (version 102) header without the OLDFILEUID/NEWFILEUID lines, but an XML-style body: closed tags, on one line. SEVERITY written `Info`. No time zone.
The OFX 2.2 XML variant (an SGML variant also exists). NAME and MEMO both carry the description. Rendered without INTU.BID (Quicken lists 14545), so as plain .ofx.
OFX 1.0.2 SGML on a single line, LANGUAGE written `eng`, DTUSER present, no time zone. Real files mask ACCTID.

PayPal Credit (issued by Synchrony), late-2025 shape: `[-8:PST]` on DTSERVER but date-only DTPOSTED and DTUSER. Real files can have empty NAME elements (not rendered). No CSV sample found for any Synchrony card.

Reconstructed. The Quicken FI directory lists a Web Connect (QFX) download, which gives the INTU.BID; ORG and FID are the institution's Direct Connect values where public, otherwise assumed. No public sample file or CSV layout was found.
